Goblin_Cleric
Devout Mezzka is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.
“
You hungry? The dwarf's gettin' good an' crispy.
„
— Mezzka, chatting about the camp's cooking

Involvement

Act One

Devout Mezzka can be found chasing a chicken in the main outdoor area of the Goblin Camp. If the  Owlbear Cub is present, Mezzka and  Krolla can be found discussing their replacement 'chicken'. After a game of chicken chasing, Mezzka will endlessly chase whichever 'chicken' is available. If the cub is not in the camp or was freed, Mezzka can be found near  Puli and  Mirg, occasionally wandering to the booze tub for refills.
